From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: POC sprint — Recap and next steps

Thanks again for a productive session on Friday. Below is a concise recap and owners for the action items we agreed on.

Recap:
- Session covered prompt calibration (Laura led), routing policies and fallback (Sergio), and a short smoke load run (Neha monitored). No regressions in latency observed for the 3-minute run; KV cache warmed within two minutes.

Action items (owner — due):
- FinTechCo: Confirm whitelist applied to our test IPs and share confirmation email (ops@fintechco.com) — Due Wed Feb 24 EOD
- Laura Bennett: Deliver annotated prompt checklist with suggested guardrails and sample-of-6 prompts (attachment) — Due Tue Feb 23 12:00 PM PST
- Neha Kapoor: Share dashboard link and one-page runbook for the smoke run (includes alert thresholds + rollback steps) — Due Tue Feb 23 10:00 AM PST
- Sergio Alvarez: Draft proposal for the next hands-on (deep load test + A/B fallback experiment) and share preliminary timeline and cost estimate — Due Fri Feb 26 EOD

Notes:
- We observed a small token-cost delta when the fallback model triggered; Laura will include a short note in the checklist to help prioritize prompts to avoid unnecessary fallbacks.
- FinTechCo requested a dedicated follow-up to cover procurement and contract milestones; we'll loop in Solutions Engineering and Legal once FinTechCo confirms internal timelines.

Attachments: POC-Agenda-v2.pdf; redwood-loadplan-20270218.csv; Laura-prompt-checklist-draft.pdf (will be shared by Laura when ready)

Next session: proposed week of Mar 8 — Sergio to propose two dates by Fri Feb 26.

Thanks,
